description.en: Checks a message against the active Booga Town competition answer.
description.de: Prüft eine Nachricht gegen die aktive Booga-Town-Wettbewerbsantwort.
description.es: Comprueba un mensaje contra la respuesta activa de Booga Town.
description.fr: Vérifie un message par rapport à la réponse active du concours Booga Town.
description.it: Controlla un messaggio rispetto alla risposta attiva della competizione Booga Town.
description.ro: Verifică un mesaj față de răspunsul activ al competiției Booga Town.

inputs.name: correct
inputs.modifier: transform:() => { const raw='{{state.competition}}'; if(!raw) return false; const d=JSON.parse(raw); if(!d.active) return false; return '{{JOAI_MESSAGE_TEXT}}'.trim().toLowerCase() === String(d.active.answer).trim().toLowerCase(); }

inputs.name: dataJson
inputs.modifier: transform:() => { const raw='{{state.competition}}'; if(!raw) return ''; const d=JSON.parse(raw); if(!d.active) return raw; const ok='{{JOAI_MESSAGE_TEXT}}'.trim().toLowerCase() === String(d.active.answer).trim().toLowerCase(); if(!ok) return raw; d.active=null; return JSON.stringify(d); }

inputs.name: message
inputs.modifier: transform:() => { const raw='{{state.competition}}'; if(!raw) return ''; const d=JSON.parse(raw); if(!d.active) return ''; const ok='{{JOAI_MESSAGE_TEXT}}'.trim().toLowerCase() === String(d.active.answer).trim().toLowerCase(); return ok ? '🎉 ' + '{{JOAI_SENDER_NAME}}' + ' got it! The answer was ' + d.active.answer + '.' : ''; }
